retained_dataset.note: post-5-core fixed dataset/catalog counts; not necessarily equal to unique training items

local_gap.notes: Local gaps computed from consecutive interactions; log1p applied; z-score normalization; shorter gaps due to ~3-year span vs 18-year Amazon

recency.notes: Recency is the elapsed time in days from each historical interaction to the final observable interaction of each training prefix; log1p is applied and scale-only normalization is used without mean centering (std=1.892).

effective_sequence_length.notes: Effective sequence length = min(actual_length, max_seq_len=50); log1p applied; z-score normalization. Higher mean reflects denser rating behavior in MovieLens.

activity_span.notes: Activity span from first to final retained interaction within each training instance; log1p applied; z-score normalization; lower std due to fixed ~943-day observation window

mean_local_gap.notes: Mean local gap per training instance over adjacent retained positions; no transform; z-score normalization; much lower than Amazon due to denser rating behavior

temporal_prior_mean.explanation: temporal_prior r = exp(-γ * normalized_recency), where γ=0.6 for MovieLens
temporal_prior_mean.notes: Mean temporal prior over valid retained positions, computed for each training instance. Range necessarily [0, 1]. Higher mean than Amazon due to smaller γ. Z-score normalization applied.

temporal_prior_dispersion.explanation: Standard deviation of temporal prior r values within each training instance
temporal_prior_dispersion.notes: Since r ∈ [0, 1], max std is 0.5. Observed mean of 0.318 is consistent with this constraint. Higher than Amazon due to more frequent interactions. Z-score normalization applied.
